paragraphs: R. Chanina. His father made a nazirite vow for him and brought him before Rabban Gamliel, who examined whether he had reached the age of vows. He said, “My teacher, if I am a minor, I will be a nazirite on my father's account; if I am of age, on my own account.” He told him, “I am certain that this one will issue rulings in Israel.” Not many days passed before he ruled: Nazir 29b. Jerusalem Nazir, end of chapter 4, has R. Chanina ben Chananyah: his father made a nazirite vow for him, etc. Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel examined whether he had grown two hairs, and he said, etc. Rabban Gamliel rose and kissed him, etc., and said, “I am certain, etc.” R. Elazar ben Tzadok said, “I saw him expound at Yavneh.” In the Babylonian Talmud there and Tosefta Niddah, chapter 5: “He brought him before Rabban Gamliel to examine him.”
